notes: iPhone fix: mobile Safari was killing the page while the ~2GB AI model loaded, so the download restarted in a loop. The full AI no longer loads on iPhone/iPad (or devices without WebGPU) — Vaulty answers there in quick-answer mode with the same live answers and guide brain, and questions never wait on the model anymore. Also fixed the chat panel sliding under the iOS keyboard: it now resizes with the keyboard so the box you type in and the newest answer stay visible. Desktop AI is unchanged — tap to download, and it sticks.
